name: Allo! ...khto tse?
source:
When the same number calls day after day, you will involuntarily begin to feel anxious. Who is this? What does this person want? Has inevitable happened?

And what will you hear from the speaker if you dare to answer?

[Translated from [url=https://sannelicht.itch.io/allo-khto-tse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当同一个号码日复一日地打来时，你会不由自主地开始感到焦虑。这是谁？这个人想要什么？不可避免的事情发生了吗？

如果你敢于回答，你会从说话者那里听到什么？

[译自[url=https://sannelicht.itch.io/allo-khto-tse]itch.io[/url]]
